text:
Passing CFLAGS=-fPIC CXXFLAGS=-fPIC to ./waf configure only compiles Ardour’s own source files (libs/audiographer/...) with -fPIC. The linker error is coming from /usr/local/lib/libtag.a(id3v2frame.cpp.o), which is a pre-existing static TagLib archive in /usr/local/lib that was built without -fPIC and is shadowing your distro’s shared libtag.so.
Because libaudiographer.so is a shared library, the x86_64 ELF linker cannot relocate non-PIC thread-local/static symbols (R_X86_64_TPOFF32) from a .a archive into a .so. You can either remove /usr/local/lib/libtag.a and install the distro shared dev package (sudo apt install libtag1-dev), or rebuild TagLib in /usr/local as a shared or PIC library:
cmake -B build -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=ON -DCMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE=ON
cmake --build build && sudo cmake --install build

After that, re-run ./waf configure && ./waf and libaudiographer.so will link cleanly.
